exposure: Cesarean section surgery before aortic repair after acute type A aortic dissection (ATAAD) during pregnancy
cohort: Six pregnant women who underwent ATAAD repair
finding: The study suggests that ATAAD repair can be safely performed in the third trimester after cesarean section, with favorable maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section before aortic repair in the context of ATAAD during the third trimester appears to be safe and result in favorable maternal and fetal outcomes.
